tail:
Completed Batch 30 with 14 A-page items and one B-page example. I added a proved A-page lemma for \(\sqrt2<\pi/2\), removing the example’s dependency on another B page. The lemma follows Schmeiser’s cosine-series and first-zero setup; the source is recorded and fetch-verified. ([Schmeiser PDF](https://homepage.univie.ac.at/christian.schmeiser/einfanalysis.pdf))

Six items are recorded **ready** and nine **escalated**. Escalations are due to the absent QC09 circuit-semantics and resource suppliers, plus the incomplete QC11 fixed-arity QSD interface and its open diagonal-migration proof.

Scoped precheck, rendercheck, depcheck, content-policy, proof-layout, citation-fidelity, and source-fetch checks passed; 7/7 sources are verified. The proof-contract check retains five missing-quote errors for absent suppliers, with no excerpts invented. The run-wide dependency-level check reports 85 errors outside Batch 30 and none for this batch’s items.

Key records: [A page](/home/lazyinspirit/Projects/prestige-math-library/library/quantum-algorithms/quantum-fourier-transform-circuits.md), [B page](/home/lazyinspirit/Projects/prestige-math-library/library/quantum-algorithms/quantum-fourier-transform-circuits-examples.md), [new inequality lemma](/home/lazyinspirit/Projects/prestige-math-library/items/lem-qa-pi-over-two-exceeds-sqrt-two.md), [batch notes](/home/lazyinspirit/Projects/prestige-math-library/research/quantum-computing-algorithms-60-2026-10-15-batch-30.notes.md), and [proof contracts](/home/lazyinspirit/Projects/prestige-math-library/research/quantum-computing-algorithms-60-2026-10-15-batch-30.proof-contracts.json).
